title: DiD It in 87 Minutes: A Label-Free Softmax-to-Linear Adaptation of Vision Transformers for Object Detection
abstract: arXiv:2608.22368v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While linear attention is a compelling mechanism for high-resolution object detection due to its reduced cost for global token mixing, converting the Softmax-attention ViT backbone of a trained detector into a linear-attention one is not a trivial drop-in replacement. Directly swapping the attention operator leads to severe performance degradation, and generic label-free distillation, though effective for classification, often fails on detection tasks. We argue that the central challenge is \textit{detector-interface preservation}: the converted backbone must reproduce the exact feature tensors expected by the fixed downstream detector, rather than merely imitating internal Softmax hidden states. To address this, we introduce Detector-Interface Distillation (DiD), a label-free conversion method that exclusively trains the linear-attention backbone by aligning detector-facing interface tensors with those of a frozen Softmax teacher. translated_title: 87分钟内完成：一种无标签的视觉Transformer软最大到线性注意力适配方法用于目标检测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.22368v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：虽然线性注意力因其在高分辨率目标检测中降低全局令牌混合成本而成为一种有吸引力的机制，但将训练好的检测器的Softmax注意力ViT骨干转换为线性注意力并非简单的替换。直接交换注意力算子会导致严重的性能下降，而通用的无标签蒸馏虽然对分类有效，但在检测任务上往往失败。我们认为核心挑战是\textit{检测器接口保持}：转换后的骨干必须再现固定下游检测器期望的精确特征张量，而不仅仅是模仿内部Softmax隐藏状态。为解决这一问题，我们引入了检测器接口蒸馏（DiD），一种无标签转换方法，它仅通过将线性注意力骨干的检测器面向接口张量与冻结的Softmax教师对齐来训练该骨干。
tldr: 本文提出检测器接口蒸馏（DiD），一种无标签方法，通过仅对齐检测器面向的接口张量而非内部隐藏状态，在87分钟内将Softmax注意力ViT骨干高效转换为线性注意力，从而保持目标检测性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Detector-Interface Distillation (DiD), a label-free method that efficiently converts Softmax-attention ViT backbones to linear attention in 87 minutes by aligning only detector-facing interface tensors, not internal hidden states, to preserve object detection performance.
